lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the mid-lateral region exhibits a structured grid-like arrangement of approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible lattice pattern across the mid-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and deep shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered in the lower-medial section.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vermiculated or labyrinthine pattern of high-luminance pixel lines is present in the anterior region immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into discrete blobs further back.
